summary: acer aspire 5 15: This laptop features a 15.6-inch Full HD display, 10th Gen Intel Core i7 processor, 16GB DDR4 RAM, and 512GB NVMe SSD storage. It also has a 2MP webcam, backlit keyboard, and a 3-cell battery with up to 8 hours of battery life.
detected_fault: Faulty display panel causing pixelation and screen tearing issues.
suggested_solution: Replace the display panel with a new one from a reputable manufacturer.
